name: Console
description: Run Skyrim console commands that make the player's Console wish real in the game, only when a note in the newest message asks for it.
note: Needs the Integration Hub's Console button (MCM: Console on and a Console hotkey), ConsoleUtilSSE NG and Advanced Actions on in Mantella. Offered only on the reply right after you use the Console button; every command is shown to you first and runs only if you pick Run.

commands.description: Skyrim console commands, one per item, exactly as typed in the console (at most 5). Empty if there is no safe, exact command.

summary.description: One plain line saying what the commands make true, as a fact; or why the list is empty.

prompt: Only when a note asks you to make the player's Console wish real, begin your response with '{key}:'
